gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: The overall result in 2024 benefitted from the higher yield investment environment and a prior year reserve release of GBP 19.7m (2023: GBP 13.4).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war IBNR reduced from GBP 18.0m (2023) to GBP 4.7m (2024), covering War on Land, Aviation War and Credit and Political Risk losses. This represents a release of GBP 13.3m.

named_events.loss_description: Ceased to write Aviation War in 2023 due to lack of improvements in market conditions after the Russia/Ukraine losses.

Net reserves, including outwards reinstatement premiums, booked in response to this event continue to be held at $35.7m. Net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war IBNR is currently held at GBP 4.7m (2023: GBP 18.0m).
Monitored exposure to other recent geopolitical events (e.g. Israel/Gaza) and has not identified any material losses from these.
Unlikely to have any material impact on the estimates made in drawing up these financial statements.

gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1221 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 19.7 million in 2024, contributing to an improved underwriting combined ratio. The syndicate continues to monitor geopolitical events such as the Russia/Ukraine war, which saw a reduction in IBNR for related losses, and also considers the impact of climate change, social inflation, and economic inflation on its reserves.
